title: Boryeong Mud Festival 2026: What to Pack and How to Do It From Seoul

scenes.narration: Boryeong Mud Festival is the one Korea summer event where your outfit is basically supposed to lose.
captionBeats:

scenes.narration: The 2026 dates are July twenty-fourth to August ninth, at Daecheon Beach, about two hundred kilometers from Seoul.
captionBeats:

scenes.narration: It is not one mud pit. It is slides, pools, beach energy, performances, and a lot of people making questionable but memorable choices.

scenes.narration: Your packing list is the difference between hilarious and miserable: phone pouch, water shoes, sunscreen, towel, and a dry change.

scenes.narration: If you go from Seoul, decide your return plan before you get muddy. Train, bus, shuttle, or overnight, but do not freestyle it at night.
